reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis misinterprets the baseline: the research question states the alloy already has low hardness/strength in the simple solid-solution state, yet the hypothesis attributes this to recovery/recrystallization after cold-rolling, which is a different condition.
reasons.testability: The proposed test compares cold-rolled vs. annealed states, which does not directly test why the starting (as-cast/annealed) solid-solution state has low hardness/strength; it tests a post-deformation recovery mechanism instead.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis addresses a different scenario (post-deformation softening) than the question's core problem (inherent low strength of the undeformed solid-solution state), making it of little use for explaining the reported property combination.
